content:
alex: quick smoke check — noticed KV prefix cache hitrate dropped ~12% on node-7 after the last canary. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/kv/node7?from=now-1h

infra-bot: deploy canary finished on cluster-3 (canary id c-9821) :white_check_mark:

maria: @alex can you paste the top metrics? hitrate, lookups/s, evictions/s

alex: hitrate: 0.78 -> 0.66 in 15m
lookups/s stable ~12k
evictions/s spiked 600->1800
kv_frag_pct: 4.2 -> 12.7

jonathan: can someone run a quick profiler on node-7? prefer lightweight pstack + kv-metrics sampler. if you don't have perms i can remote in.

sophie: I'll run it now. grabbing sudo. running:
```
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv_sampler --node node-7 --duration 60 --output /tmp/kv-sample.json
pstack $(pidof redwood-kv)
```

sophie: sampler done, attaching gist https://gist.github.com/sophie/abcd1234 (sample shows high prefix collisions on slot 42)

alex: logs (filtered):
```
[2024-10-12T14:02:11Z] kv: evict prefix_id=42 slot=17 reason=slot_limit
[2024-10-12T14:02:12Z] kv: evict prefix_id=42 slot=22 reason=slot_limit
[2024-10-12T14:02:14Z] kv: cache_miss prefix_id=42 key=... 
```

maria: fragmentation up + collisions... could be allocator fragmentation after the canary changed prefix hashing. @jonathan any quick regression in hashing code?

jonathan: I pushed a small change to prefix-hash last week (PR #2876) that landed in canary. It changed mod N -> faster murmur with slot remap. Might be that. I'll revert the canary on node-7 to confirm.

deploy-bot: rollback started for canary c-9821 on cluster-3 by jonathan

sophie: after rollback hitrate creeping back up to 0.74 in 6m :eyes:

maria: nice. can we add a unit/regression test for hash distribution and a small sampling smoke to release checklist? ticket INF-4321

alex: agreed. thanks for quick turnaround. will follow up in INF-4321 with perf numbers and next steps. :thumbsup:
